data.one_liner: Provides collapsible and expandable app bars with automatic snapping behaviors.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies the integration of collapsible and expandable app bars in Flutter scroll views. It offers smooth transitions responding to user scrolling and automatically snaps to the appropriate mode when scrolling stops midway.
use_when: You need custom collapsible and expandable app bars with smooth scrolling transitions.
You want automatic snapping behavior when a user stops scrolling midway through expanding or collapsing.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material SliverAppBar without custom expansion or snap animations.
strengths: Offers smooth transitions and automatic snapping to collapsed or expanded modes.
Highly customizable with properties like custom backgrounds, scroll controllers, and animation curves.
Includes helper components for collapsed and expanded app bar contents.
weaknesses: Limited to sliver and app bar use cases.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
data.minimal_example:
SliverSnap(
  expandedContentHeight: 400,
  expandedContent: const Center(child: Text('Expanded')),
  collapsedContent: const Text('Collapsed'),
  body: const Placeholder(),
)
